name: – After § 23 – Am 9
title: Resolution on continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
part_text: 23a. Recalls the massacres of Poles in Volhynia and Eastern Galicia from 1943 to 1945, which were committed by members of the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA); stresses Ukraine’s obligation to apologise in full for these atrocities, allow the exhumation of the all victims and prohibit the veneration of the historical personalities responsible for the massacres;
